notes: Job READCUST step STEP05: CBCUS01C reads CardDemo's customer master (the CUSTDATA KSDS, custdata.txt) in key order and DISPLAYs each CUSTOMER-RECORD on SYSOUT; it writes no file, so SYSOUT, RETURN-CODE and the abend are the outputs compared. Every record is DISPLAYed TWICE -- once in 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT on status '00' and again in the main loop (the program's defect: CBACT02C has the first DISPLAY commented out). Every input is the corpus's data. Derived from CardDemo (Apache-2.0; Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates): LICENSE and NOTICE here are the source's own.

faults.name: open-custfile
faults.why: 35: OPEN of a file that is not present (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): 'ERROR OPENING CUSTFILE' from 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN, Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then Z-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: open-custfile-verified
faults.why: 97: OPEN successful, file integrity verified (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) -- a SUCCESSFUL open, but 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN accepts only '00', so the step abends (the program's defect) through Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS's 9 arm, then Z-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: custfile-read-error
faults.why: 30: permanent I/O error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) on the third customer: 'ERROR READING ...' from 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT after two customers are displayed, Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then Z-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: custfile-early-end
faults.why: 10: end of file (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) after two customers: END-OF-FILE is set, the file is closed and the step ends normally with what it has displayed

faults.name: custfile-status-9
faults.why: 9x: implementor-defined condition (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT -> Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS's non-numeric / 9 arm, then Z-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: close-custfile
faults.why: 30: permanent I/O error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) closing CUSTFILE after every record is displayed: 'ERROR CLOSING ...' from 9000-CUSTFILE-CLOSE, Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then Z-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999
